description: Real-world files for the fidelity corpus. tools/fetch-corpus.sh downloads each url to fixtures/<file> and checks its SHA-256; nothing here is executed.
selection: Candidates of 8 KB to 4 MB from each source, ordered by SHA-256 of a fixed seed and the path, taken in that order before any tool scored them. Skipped: files that are not readable zips, have no main part, unpack past 120 MB, come from fuzzers, or hold an email address outside example or project domains.
derived_note: Committed files made from the downloaded ones: python-pptx dumps of each deck, text included, for the reader test. They carry the licence of the deck they come from.
